name: PJLink Projector (Class 1 & 2)
author: Control-It Community
subtitle: Standard Video Projector Control over TCP
descriptionText: Universal PJLink Class 1 & 2 projector driver with MD5 challenge-response authentication, power control, input selection, audio/video muting, and lamp telemetry.

setupFields.label: Projector IP Address
setupFields.helpText: Network IP address of your PJLink projector.

setupFields.label: PJLink Password (Optional)
setupFields.placeholder: Enter password if security is enabled
setupFields.helpText: MD5 challenge authentication password if configured on the projector.

variables.name: Projector Power Status
variables.descriptionText: Current power state (ON, STANDBY, COOLING, WARMING)

variables.name: Active Input Source
variables.descriptionText: Active input code (31 = HDMI 1, 32 = HDMI 2, 11 = RGB)

variables.name: Lamp / Laser Hours
variables.descriptionText: Accumulated lamp or laser run hours

actions.title: Set Projector Power
actions.subtitle: Power On or Standby
actions.descriptionText: Turns projector power on or switches to standby mode.

actions.title: Switch Input Source
actions.subtitle: Select HDMI, RGB, or Video Input
actions.descriptionText: Changes the active display input source.

actions.title: Audio / Video Mute
actions.subtitle: Blank screen or mute audio
actions.descriptionText: Mutes or un-mutes the video shutter and audio output.

actions.title: Query Projector Status
actions.subtitle: Poll power, input, and lamp hours
actions.descriptionText: Queries current projector power state, active input source, and lamp run hours.
